stories.summary: The Guardian praises Nintendo’s Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time as a modern transformation of the landmark game. The review says it is clearer, easier to navigate and more beautiful, with playful musical touches, while retaining the original’s melancholy.

stories.title: Beijing Signals Readiness to Talk to Trump's Team, Even Old Foes
stories.summary: Beijing has signalled that it is prepared to engage with President Trump’s team, including officials known for criticising China. The Wall Street Journal reports that China’s foreign minister spoke by phone with new US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, a longstanding critic of Beijing.

stories.title: Trump Says Colombia Will Accept Deportees, Ending Tariff Standoff
stories.summary: President Trump says Colombia has agreed to accept deportees, ending a tariff standoff between the two countries. The Wall Street Journal places the dispute within Trump’s early second-term immigration push, during which ICE made more than 900 arrests on Sunday.
